        self.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.grid_rowconfigure(0, weight=3) # Give more space to images

        # Left side for the sample image
        sample_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(paned_window, text="Sample Image")
        paned_window.add(sample_frame, weight=1)

        # Right side for the reference image
        reference_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(paned_window, text="Reference Image")
        paned_window.add(reference_frame, weight=1)

        # Sample image canvas
        self.sample_canvas = tk.Canvas(sample_frame, bg="gray")
        self.sample_canvas.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Reference image canvas
        self.reference_canvas = tk.Canvas(reference_frame, bg="lightgray")
        self.reference_canvas.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Control Frame
        control_frame = ttk.Frame(self) # Attach to self (MainApplication)
        control_frame.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky=(tk.E, tk.W), padx=10, pady=5)
        self.grid_rowconfigure(1, weight=0) # Control frame doesn't expand vertically

        # Results Panel at the bottom
        results_panel = ttk.LabelFrame(self, text="Comparison Results")
        results_panel.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky=(tk.N, tk.S, tk.E, tk.W), padx=10, pady=5)
        self.grid_rowconfigure(2, weight=1) # Results panel expands vertically

        self.comparison_results_text = tk.Text(results_panel, wrap=tk.WORD, state=tk.DISABLED, height=10)
        self.comparison_results_text.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        results_scrollbar = ttk.Scrollbar(results_panel, command=self.comparison_results_text.yview)
        results_scrollbar.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        self.comparison_results_text.config(yscrollcommand=results_scrollbar.set)

        self.draw_roi_button = ttk.Checkbutton(
            control_frame,
            text="Draw ROI",
            variable=self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled,
            command=self._toggle_roi_drawing_mode,
            style="ToggleButton.TCheckbutton"
        )
        self.draw_roi_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        self.define_alignment_button = ttk.Checkbutton(
            control_frame,
            text="Define Alignment Points",
            variable=self.alignment_mode_enabled,
            command=self._toggle_alignment_mode,
            style="ToggleButton.TCheckbutton"
        )
        self.define_alignment_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        self.toggle_camera_button = ttk.Checkbutton(
            control_frame,
            text="Toggle Camera",
            variable=self.camera_active_var, # Use the instance variable
            command=self._toggle_camera,
            style="ToggleButton.TCheckbutton"
        )
        self.toggle_camera_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        self.perform_alignment_button = ttk.Button(
            control_frame,
            text="Perform Alignment",
            command=self._perform_alignment
        )
        self.perform_alignment_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        self.perform_comparison_button = ttk.Button(
            control_frame,
            text="Perform Comparison",
            command=self._perform_comparison
        )
        self.perform_comparison_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        # Style for the Checkbutton to look like a toggle button
        style = ttk.Style()
        style.configure("ToggleButton.TCheckbutton", font=("TkDefaultFont", 10), padding=5)
        style.map("ToggleButton.TCheckbutton",
                  background=[("selected", "blue"), ("!selected", "lightgray")],
                  foreground=[("selected", "white"), ("!selected", "black")])

    def _toggle_roi_drawing_mode(self):
        if self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.get():
            print("ROI Drawing Mode Enabled")
            self.reference_canvas.config(cursor="cross")
            self._deselect_roi() # Deselect any ROI when entering drawing mode
            self.alignment_mode_enabled.set(False) # Disable alignment mode
            self._clear_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_point_ids) # Clear alignment points on canvas
            self.reference_alignment_points.clear() # Clear stored points
            self.reference_alignment_point_ids.clear()
        else:
            print("ROI Drawing Mode Disabled")
            self.reference_canvas.config(cursor="")

    def _toggle_alignment_mode(self):
        if self.alignment_mode_enabled.get():
            print("Alignment Mode Enabled")
            self.reference_canvas.config(cursor="cross")
            self._deselect_roi() # Deselect any ROI when entering alignment mode
            self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.set(False) # Disable ROI drawing mode
            self._clear_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_point_ids) # Clear existing points when re-entering mode
            self.reference_alignment_points.clear() # Clear stored points
            self.reference_alignment_point_ids.clear()
            self._clear_alignment_points(self.sample_canvas, self.sample_alignment_point_ids) # Clear existing points when re-entering mode
            self.sample_alignment_points.clear() # Clear stored points
            self.sample_alignment_point_ids.clear()
        else:
            print("Alignment Mode Disabled")
            self.reference_canvas.config(cursor="")

    def _on_mouse_down(self, event):
        if self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.get() and self.reference_pillow_image:
            self._deselect_roi() # Deselect existing ROI when starting a new draw
            self.start_x = self.reference_canvas.canvasx(event.x)
            self.start_y = self.reference_canvas.canvasy(event.y)
            self.current_roi_rect_id = self.reference_canvas.create_rectangle(
                self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y,
                outline="red", width=2, tags="roi_rect"
            )
        elif self.alignment_mode_enabled.get() and self.reference_pillow_image:
            if len(self.reference_alignment_points) < 4:
                x, y = self.reference_canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.reference_canvas.canvasy(event.y)
                self.reference_alignment_points.append((x, y))
                self._draw_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_points, self.reference_alignment_point_ids)
                print(f"Reference point {len(self.reference_alignment_points)}: ({x}, {y})")
                if len(self.reference_alignment_points) == 4:
                    messagebox.showinfo("Alignment Points", "Four alignment points selected for reference image.")
            else:
                messagebox.showinfo("Alignment Points", "Four alignment points already selected. Clearing previous points.")
                self._clear_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_point_ids)
                self.reference_alignment_points.clear()
                x, y = self.reference_canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.reference_canvas.canvasy(event.y)
                self.reference_alignment_points.append((x, y))
                self._draw_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_points, self.reference_alignment_point_ids)
                print(f"Reference point 1: ({x}, {y})")
        elif not self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.get() and not self.alignment_mode_enabled.get(): # ROI selection mode
            self._select_roi_at_coords(event.x, event.y)


    def _on_mouse_drag(self, event):
        if self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.get() and self.current_roi_rect_id:
            cur_x = self.reference_canvas.canvasx(event.x)
            cur_y = self.reference_canvas.canvasy(event.y)
            self.reference_canvas.coords(self.current_roi_rect_id, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def _on_mouse_up(self, event):
        if self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.get() and self.current_roi_rect_id:
            end_x = self.reference_canvas.canvasx(event.x)
            end_y = self.reference_canvas.canvasy(event.y)

            # Ensure start < end for rectangle coordinates
            x1, y1 = min(self.start_x, end_x), min(self.start_y, end_y)
            x2, y2 = max(self.start_x, end_x), max(self.start_y, end_y)

            # Check for minimum size to avoid tiny ROIs
            if abs(x2 - x1) < 5 or abs(y2 - y1) < 5: # 5 pixel minimum size
                self.reference_canvas.delete(self.current_roi_rect_id)
                self.current_roi_rect_id = None
                self.start_x = None
                self.start_y = None
                return

            # Get canvas dimensions
            canvas_width = self.reference_canvas.winfo_width()
            canvas_height = self.reference_canvas.winfo_height()

            # If no reference image is loaded, cannot normalize. Delete ROI.
            if not self.reference_pillow_image:
                self.reference_canvas.delete(self.current_roi_rect_id)
                self.current_roi_rect_id = None
                self.start_x = None
                self.start_y = None
                messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Please load a reference image before drawing ROIs.")
                return

            original_img_width, original_img_height = self.reference_pillow_image.size
                
            # Calculate the dimensions of the *displayed* image on the canvas
            img_ratio = original_img_width / original_img_height
            canvas_ratio = canvas_width / canvas_height
            
            displayed_img_width = canvas_width
            displayed_img_height = int(canvas_width / img_ratio)
            
            if displayed_img_height > canvas_height:
                displayed_img_height = canvas_height
                displayed_img_width = int(canvas_height * img_ratio)

            # Calculate offset if image is not centered
            offset_x = (canvas_width - displayed_img_width) / 2
            offset_y = (canvas_height - displayed_img_height) / 2
            
            # Convert canvas pixel coordinates to normalized (0-1 range) relative to the *displayed* image
            norm_x1 = (x1 - offset_x) / displayed_img_width
            norm_y1 = (y1 - offset_y) / displayed_img_height
            norm_x2 = (x2 - offset_x) / displayed_img_width
            norm_y2 = (y2 - offset_y) / displayed_img_height
            
            # Clamp normalized coordinates to [0, 1] range
            norm_x1 = max(0.0, min(1.0, norm_x1))
            norm_y1 = max(0.0, min(1.0, norm_y1))
            norm_x2 = max(0.0, min(1.0, norm_x2))
            norm_y2 = max(0.0, min(1.0, norm_y2))

            roi_name = simpledialog.askstring("ROI Name", "Enter name for this ROI:")
            if roi_name:
                new_roi = {
                    "canvas_id_rect": self.current_roi_rect_id, # Store the canvas object ID for the rectangle
                    "canvas_id_text": None, # Will be set during redraw
                    "name": roi_name,
                    "coords_normalized": (norm_x1, norm_y1, norm_x2, norm_y2),
                    "comparison_mode": "OCR" # Default mode
                }
                self.rois.append(new_roi)
                print(f"Added ROI: {new_roi}")
                self._redraw_rois() # Redraw all ROIs to correctly display the new one with its name
            else:
                self.reference_canvas.delete(self.current_roi_rect_id) # Delete if no name
            
            self.current_roi_rect_id = None
            self.start_x = None
            self.start_y = None

    def _on_sample_mouse_down(self, event):
        if self.alignment_mode_enabled.get() and self.sample_pillow_image:
            if len(self.sample_alignment_points) < 4:
                x, y = self.sample_canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.sample_canvas.canvasy(event.y)
                self.sample_alignment_points.append((x, y))
                self._draw_alignment_points(self.sample_canvas, self.sample_alignment_points, self.sample_alignment_point_ids)
                print(f"Sample point {len(self.sample_alignment_points)}: ({x}, {y})")
                if len(self.sample_alignment_points) == 4:
                    messagebox.showinfo("Alignment Points", "Four alignment points selected for sample image.")
            else:
                messagebox.showinfo("Alignment Points", "Four alignment points already selected. Clearing previous points.")
                self._clear_alignment_points(self.sample_canvas, self.sample_alignment_point_ids)
                self.sample_alignment_points.clear()
                x, y = self.sample_canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.sample_canvas.canvasy(event.y)
                self.sample_alignment_points.append((x, y))
                self._draw_alignment_points(self.sample_canvas, self.sample_alignment_points, self.sample_alignment_point_ids)
                print(f"Sample point 1: ({x}, {y})")

    def _perform_alignment(self):
        if not self.reference_pillow_image:
            messagebox.showwarning("Alignment", "Please load a reference image first.")
            return
        if not self.sample_pillow_image:
            messagebox.showwarning("Alignment", "Please load a sample image or start camera first.")
            return

        if len(self.reference_alignment_points) != 4:
            messagebox.showwarning("Alignment", "Please select 4 alignment points on the reference image.")
            return
        if len(self.sample_alignment_points) != 4:
            messagebox.showwarning("Alignment", "Please select 4 alignment points on the sample image.")
            return
        
        # Ensure alignment mode is off after defining points
        self.alignment_mode_enabled.set(False) 

        # Call the processing function
        aligned_img = perform_homography_alignment(
            self.reference_pillow_image,
            self.sample_pillow_image,
            self.reference_alignment_points,
            self.sample_alignment_points
        )

        if aligned_img:
            self.aligned_sample_image = aligned_img
            # Display the aligned image on the sample canvas
            self._update_canvas_image(self.sample_canvas, self.aligned_sample_image, 'sample_tk_image')
            messagebox.showinfo("Alignment", "Image alignment successful!")
        else:
            messagebox.showerror("Alignment", "Failed to perform homography alignment. Check selected points.")

    def _perform_comparison(self):
        if not self.reference_pillow_image:
            messagebox.showwarning("Comparison", "Please load a reference image first.")
            return
        if not self.aligned_sample_image:
            messagebox.showwarning("Comparison", "Please perform alignment first.")
            return
        if not self.rois:
            messagebox.showwarning("Comparison", "Please define ROIs first.")
            return

        all_comparison_results = []
        for i, roi in enumerate(self.rois):
            if roi["comparison_mode"] == "OCR":
                # Temporarily disable OCR processing due to Tesseract not found
                result_str = (
                    f"ROI '{roi['name']}' (OCR Mode):\n"
                    f"  OCR processing temporarily disabled. Tesseract OCR engine not found.\n"
                    f"  Please install Tesseract and ensure it's in your system PATH.\n"
                    f"  See README for more details.\n"
                    "-----------------------------------------\n"
                )
                all_comparison_results.append(result_str)
            elif roi["comparison_mode"] == "Shape":
                # Perform shape comparison
                shape_comparison_result = compare_shapes_in_roi(
                    self.reference_pillow_image,
                    self.aligned_sample_image,
                    roi["coords_normalized"]
                )
                result_str = (
                    f"ROI '{roi['name']}' (Shape Mode):\n"
                    f"  Match Score (lower is better): {shape_comparison_result['match_score']:.3f}\n"
                    f"  Pass/Fail: {'Pass' if shape_comparison_result['pass_fail'] else 'Fail'}\n"
                    "-----------------------------------------\n"
                )
                all_comparison_results.append(result_str)
            else:
                result_str = (
                    f"ROI '{roi['name']}' (Unknown Mode: {roi['comparison_mode']}):\n"
                    f"  Comparison mode not recognized.\n"
                    "-----------------------------------------\n"
                )
                all_comparison_results.append(result_str)

        # Clear previous results
        self.comparison_results_text.config(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.comparison_results_text.delete(1.0, tk.END)

        if all_comparison_results:
            self.comparison_results_text.insert(tk.END, "".join(all_comparison_results))
        else:
            self.comparison_results_text.insert(tk.END, "No ROIs defined for comparison.")
        
        self.comparison_results_text.config(state=tk.DISABLED)


    def _on_right_click(self, event):
        if not self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.get():
            self._select_roi_at_coords(event.x, event.y)
            if self.selected_roi:
                # Create a popup menu
                context_menu = tk.Menu(self.reference_canvas, tearoff=0)
                context_menu.add_command(label=f"Rename '{self.selected_roi['name']}'", command=self._rename_selected_roi)
                
                # Submenu for comparison mode
                mode_menu = tk.Menu(context_menu, tearoff=0)
                mode_menu.add_command(label="OCR Comparison", command=lambda: self._change_selected_roi_mode("OCR"))
                mode_menu.add_command(label="Shape Comparison", command=lambda: self._change_selected_roi_mode("Shape"))
                context_menu.add_cascade(label=f"Mode: {self.selected_roi['comparison_mode']}", menu=mode_menu)
                
                context_menu.add_separator()
                context_menu.add_command(label=f"Delete '{self.selected_roi['name']}'", command=self._delete_selected_roi)
                
                context_menu.post(event.x_root, event.y_root)
            else:
                # No ROI selected, maybe a general menu or do nothing
                pass

    def _select_roi_at_coords(self, x, y):
        # Find all items at the clicked coordinates that have the "roi_rect" tag
        overlapping_items = self.reference_canvas.find_overlapping(x, y, x, y)
        roi_item_ids = [item_id for item_id in overlapping_items if "roi_rect" in self.reference_canvas.gettags(item_id)]

        self._deselect_roi() # Deselect any previously selected ROI

        if roi_item_ids:
            # Assume the top-most (last drawn) ROI is the intended selection if multiple overlap
            selected_canvas_id = roi_item_ids[-1] 
            
            for roi in self.rois:
                if roi["canvas_id_rect"] == selected_canvas_id:
                    self.selected_roi = roi
                    self.reference_canvas.itemconfig(self.selected_roi["canvas_id_rect"], outline="blue", width=3)
                    if self.selected_roi["canvas_id_text"]:
                         self.reference_canvas.itemconfig(self.selected_roi["canvas_id_text"], fill="blue")
                    print(f"Selected ROI: {self.selected_roi['name']} (ID: {self.selected_roi['canvas_id_rect']})")
                    break
        else:
            self.selected_roi = None
            print("No ROI selected.")

    def _deselect_roi(self):
        if self.selected_roi:
            self.reference_canvas.itemconfig(self.selected_roi["canvas_id_rect"], outline="red", width=2)
            if self.selected_roi["canvas_id_text"]:
                self.reference_canvas.itemconfig(self.selected_roi["canvas_id_text"], fill="red")
            self.selected_roi = None
            print("ROI deselected.")

    def _rename_selected_roi(self):
        if self.selected_roi:

    def _draw_alignment_points(self, canvas, points_list, ids_list):
        """Draws alignment points and numbers them on the canvas."""
        for _id in ids_list: # Clear previous drawings for alignment points
            canvas.delete(_id)
        ids_list.clear()

        if not self.reference_pillow_image: # Check if an image is loaded
            return

        canvas_width = canvas.winfo_width()
        canvas_height = canvas.winfo_height()

        if canvas_width == 0 or canvas_height == 0:
            return

        original_img_width, original_img_height = self.reference_pillow_image.size

        # Calculate the dimensions of the *displayed* image on the canvas
        img_ratio = original_img_width / original_img_height
        canvas_ratio = canvas_width / canvas_height
        
        displayed_img_width = 0
        displayed_img_height = 0
        offset_x = 0
        offset_y = 0

        if img_ratio > canvas_ratio: # Image is wider relative to canvas, height is limiting factor
            displayed_img_height = canvas_height
            displayed_img_width = int(canvas_height * img_ratio)
            offset_x = (canvas_width - displayed_img_width) / 2
            offset_y = 0
        else: # Image is taller relative to canvas, width is limiting factor
            displayed_img_width = canvas_width
            displayed_img_height = int(canvas_width / img_ratio)
            offset_x = 0
            offset_y = (canvas_height - displayed_img_height) / 2

        for i, (x, y) in enumerate(points_list):
            # Draw point (small circle/rectangle)
            point_size = 5
            point_id = canvas.create_oval(
                x - point_size, y - point_size,
                x + point_size, y + point_size,
                fill="green", outline="white", width=1, tags="alignment_point"
            )
            ids_list.append(point_id)
            
            # Draw number
            text_id = canvas.create_text(
                x + point_size + 2, y - point_size - 2,
                text=str(i+1), fill="green", anchor="nw", tags="alignment_point_number"
            )
            ids_list.append(text_id)

        # Draw lines connecting points if there are at least two
        if len(points_list) >= 2:
            for i in range(len(points_list) - 1):
                x1, y1 = points_list[i]
                x2, y2 = points_list[i+1]
                line_id = canvas.create_line(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill="green", width=2, tags="alignment_line")
                ids_list.append(line_id)
            # Connect the last point to the first if 4 points are selected
            if len(points_list) == 4:
                x1, y1 = points_list[3]
                x2, y2 = points_list[0]
                line_id = canvas.create_line(x1, y1, x2, y2, fill="green", width=2, tags="alignment_line")
                ids_list.append(line_id)

    def _clear_alignment_points(self, canvas, ids_list):
        """Clears all alignment point drawings from the canvas and the IDs list."""
        for _id in ids_list:
            canvas.delete(_id)
        ids_list.clear()

    def _toggle_camera(self):
        if not self.camera_active:
            # Start camera
            self.cap = cv2.VideoCapture(0) # 0 is default camera
            if not self.cap.isOpened():
                messagebox.showerror("Camera Error", "Could not open video stream.")
                self.camera_active = False
                self.toggle_camera_button.deselect() # Uncheck the button
                return

            self.camera_active = True
            self.camera_active_var.set(True) # Set the BooleanVar to True
            self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.set(False) # Disable ROI drawing mode
            self.alignment_mode_enabled.set(False) # Disable alignment mode
            self.reference_canvas.config(cursor="")
            self.sample_canvas.config(cursor="none") # No cursor over live feed
            self.sample_pillow_image = None # Clear any loaded sample image
            self.sample_canvas.delete("all") # Clear canvas
            self.sample_alignment_points.clear()
            self._clear_alignment_points(self.sample_canvas, self.sample_alignment_point_ids)
            self.update_camera_feed()
            print("Camera Started")
        else:
            # Stop camera
            self.camera_active = False
            self.camera_active_var.set(False) # Set the BooleanVar to False
            if self.current_camera_job:
                self.parent.after_cancel(self.current_camera_job)
                self.current_camera_job = None
            if self.cap:
                self.cap.release()
                self.cap = None
            self.sample_canvas.delete("all") # Clear canvas
            self.sample_canvas.config(cursor="")
            print("Camera Stopped")

    def update_camera_feed(self):
        if self.camera_active and self.cap:
            ret, frame = self.cap.read()
            if ret:
                # Convert frame from OpenCV BGR to RGB
                cv2_image_rgb = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)
                self.sample_pillow_image = Image.fromarray(cv2_image_rgb) # Store as Pillow image

                # Resize and display on sample_canvas
                canvas_width = self.sample_canvas.winfo_width()
                canvas_height = self.sample_canvas.winfo_height()

                if canvas_width == 0 or canvas_height == 0:
                    canvas_width = 600 # sensible default
                    canvas_height = 800 # sensible default

                resized_image = self._resize_image_to_fit_canvas(self.sample_pillow_image, canvas_width, canvas_height)
                photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(resized_image)

                self.sample_canvas.delete("all")
                self.sample_canvas.create_image(canvas_width/2, canvas_height/2, image=photo, anchor=tk.CENTER)
                self.sample_tk_image = photo # Keep reference

            self.current_camera_job = self.parent.after(10, self.update_camera_feed) # Update every 10ms (approx 100fps)
        else:
            if self.current_camera_job:
                self.parent.after_cancel(self.current_camera_job)
                self.current_camera_job = None
            if self.cap:
                self.cap.release()
                self.cap = None

    def _resize_image_to_fit_canvas(self, original_image, canvas_width, canvas_height):
        """
        Resizes an image to fit within the given canvas dimensions while maintaining aspect ratio.
        Returns a Pillow Image object.
        """
        if not original_image:
            return None

        img_width, img_height = original_image.size
        ratio = min(canvas_width / img_width, canvas_height / img_height)
        new_width = int(img_width * ratio)
        new_height = int(img_height * ratio)

        return original_image.resize((new_width, new_height), Image.LANCZOS)

    def _update_canvas_image(self, canvas, pillow_image, tk_image_ref_attr):
        """
        Helper to display a Pillow Image on a canvas, handling resizing.
        Also redraws ROIs on the reference canvas if it's the reference canvas.
        """
        if not pillow_image:
            canvas.delete("all")
            return

        canvas_width = canvas.winfo_width()
        canvas_height = canvas.winfo_height()

        if canvas_width == 0 or canvas_height == 0:
            # Canvas not yet rendered, skip update for now
            return

        resized_image = self._resize_image_to_fit_canvas(pillow_image, canvas_width, canvas_height)
        photo = ImageTk.PhotoImage(resized_image)

        canvas.delete("all")
        canvas.create_image(canvas_width/2, canvas_height/2, image=photo, anchor=tk.CENTER)
        setattr(self, tk_image_ref_attr, photo) # Keep a reference to prevent garbage collection

        # If this is the reference canvas, redraw existing ROIs and alignment points
        if canvas == self.reference_canvas:
            self._redraw_rois()
            self._draw_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_points, self.reference_alignment_point_ids)
        elif canvas == self.sample_canvas:
            pass # No alignment points to redraw on sample canvas after alignment/warp


    def _on_canvas_resize(self, event, canvas, pillow_image):
        """
        Event handler for canvas resizing.
        """
        # Only update if the size has actually changed, to prevent infinite loops
        if event.width != canvas.winfo_width() or event.height != canvas.winfo_height():
            if canvas == self.reference_canvas:
                # Ensure the canvas dimensions are updated before calling _update_canvas_image
                # This is important because winfo_width/height might not be updated yet
                canvas.config(width=event.width, height=event.height)
                self._update_canvas_image(canvas, pillow_image, 'reference_tk_image')
            elif canvas == self.sample_canvas:
                canvas.config(width=event.width, height=event.height)
                self._update_canvas_image(canvas, pillow_image, 'sample_tk_image')


    def _load_image_into_memory(self, file_path):
        """
        Loads an image from file path into a Pillow Image object.
        """
        try:
            return Image.open(file_path)
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to load image: {e}")
            return None

    def _open_reference_image(self):
        file_path = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            filetypes=[("Image files", "*.png *.jpg *.jpeg *.bmp *.gif")]
        )
        if file_path:
            self.reference_pillow_image = self._load_image_into_memory(file_path)
            if self.reference_pillow_image:
                self.parent.title(f"ROI-Inspector - Reference: {os.path.basename(file_path)}")
                self._update_canvas_image(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_pillow_image, 'reference_tk_image')
                self.rois.clear() # Clear ROIs when a new reference image is loaded
                self._redraw_rois() # Redraw ROIs after new image is loaded
                self.reference_alignment_points.clear() # Clear alignment points
                self._clear_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_point_ids) # Clear alignment points from canvas


    def _open_reference_pdf(self):
        file_path = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            filetypes=[("PDF files", "*.pdf")]
        )
        if file_path:
            try:
                doc = fitz.open(file_path)
                page = doc[0] # Get the first page
                # Rendering at a higher DPI for better quality, e.g., 300 DPI
                # Default is 72 DPI, which can look pixelated
                mat = fitz.Matrix(300 / 72, 300 / 72)
                pix = page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)
                
                # Convert to RGB if not already
                if pix.alpha:
                    img = Image.frombytes("RGBA", [pix.width, pix.height], pix.samples)
                else:
                    img = Image.frombytes("RGB", [pix.width, pix.height], pix.samples)

                self.reference_pillow_image = img
                if self.reference_pillow_image:
                    self.parent.title(f"ROI-Inspector - Reference PDF: {os.path.basename(file_path)}")
                    self._update_canvas_image(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_pillow_image, 'reference_tk_image')
                    self.rois.clear() # Clear ROIs when a new reference image is loaded
                    self._redraw_rois() # Redraw ROIs after new image is loaded
                    self.reference_alignment_points.clear() # Clear alignment points
                    self._clear_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_point_ids) # Clear alignment points from canvas                    
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to load PDF: {e}")
    def _open_sample_image(self):

                self._update_canvas_image(self.sample_canvas, self.sample_pillow_image, 'sample_tk_image')
                self.sample_alignment_points.clear() # Clear alignment points for sample image
                self._clear_alignment_points(self.sample_canvas, self.sample_alignment_point_ids) # Clear alignment points from sample canvas

    
    def _redraw_rois(self):
        """Redraws all stored ROIs on the reference canvas."""
        self.reference_canvas.delete("roi_rect") # Clear existing ROI rectangles
        self.reference_canvas.delete("roi_name_tag") # Clear existing ROI name tags

        if not self.reference_pillow_image:
            return

        canvas_width = self.reference_canvas.winfo_width()
        canvas_height = self.reference_canvas.winfo_height()

        if canvas_width == 0 or canvas_height == 0:
            return

        original_img_width, original_img_height = self.reference_pillow_image.size

        # Calculate the dimensions of the *displayed* image on the canvas
        img_ratio = original_img_width / original_img_height
        canvas_ratio = canvas_width / canvas_height

        displayed_img_width = 0
        displayed_img_height = 0
        offset_x = 0
        offset_y = 0

        if img_ratio > canvas_ratio: # Image is wider relative to canvas, height is limiting factor
            displayed_img_height = canvas_height
            displayed_img_width = int(canvas_height * img_ratio)
            offset_x = (canvas_width - displayed_img_width) / 2
            offset_y = 0
        else: # Image is taller relative to canvas, width is limiting factor
            displayed_img_width = canvas_width
            displayed_img_height = int(canvas_width / img_ratio)
            offset_x = 0
            offset_y = (canvas_height - displayed_img_height) / 2
        
        # Ensure displayed dimensions are not zero
        if displayed_img_width == 0 or displayed_img_height == 0:
            return


        for roi in self.rois:
            norm_x1, norm_y1, norm_x2, norm_y2 = roi["coords_normalized"]

            # Convert normalized coordinates back to canvas pixel coordinates
            x1_pixel = norm_x1 * displayed_img_width + offset_x
            y1_pixel = norm_y1 * displayed_img_height + offset_y
            x2_pixel = norm_x2 * displayed_img_width + offset_x
            y2_pixel = norm_y2 * displayed_img_height + offset_y

            current_outline_color = "blue" if self.selected_roi and self.selected_roi["canvas_id_rect"] == roi["canvas_id_rect"] else "red"
            current_outline_width = 3 if self.selected_roi and self.selected_roi["canvas_id_rect"] == roi["canvas_id_rect"] else 2


            roi_id_on_canvas_rect = self.reference_canvas.create_rectangle(
                x1_pixel, y1_pixel, x2_pixel, y2_pixel,
                outline=current_outline_color, width=current_outline_width, tags="roi_rect"
            )
            # Add text label for ROI name
            roi_id_on_canvas_text = self.reference_canvas.create_text(
                x1_pixel, y1_pixel - 10, # Slightly above the top-left corner
                text=roi["name"], fill=current_outline_color, anchor="nw", tags="roi_name_tag"
            )
            # Update the ROI's internal canvas IDs
            roi["canvas_id_rect"] = roi_id_on_canvas_rect
            roi["canvas_id_text"] = roi_id_on_canvas_text

    def _save_rois_to_json(self):
        if not self.rois:
            messagebox.showinfo("Save ROIs", "No ROIs to save.")
            return

        file_path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            defaultextension=".json",
            filetypes=[("JSON files", "*.json")],
            title="Save ROIs to JSON"
        )
        if file_path:
            # Prepare data for saving (exclude canvas IDs as they are transient)
            rois_to_save = []
            for roi in self.rois:
                rois_to_save.append({
                    "name": roi["name"],
                    "coords_normalized": roi["coords_normalized"],
                    "comparison_mode": roi["comparison_mode"]
                })
            try:
                with open(file_path, 'w') as f:
                    json.dump(rois_to_save, f, indent=4)
                messagebox.showinfo("Save ROIs", f"ROIs saved to {file_path}")
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to save ROIs: {e}")

    def _load_rois_from_json(self):
        file_path = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            filetypes=[("JSON files", "*.json")],
            title="Load ROIs from JSON"
        )
        if file_path:
            try:
                with open(file_path, 'r') as f:
                    loaded_rois_data = json.load(f)
                
                # Clear existing ROIs
                self.rois.clear()
                self._deselect_roi()
                self.reference_canvas.delete("roi_rect")
                self.reference_canvas.delete("roi_name_tag")

                # Reconstruct ROIs from loaded data
                for roi_data in loaded_rois_data:
                    # Add transient canvas IDs, which will be updated by _redraw_rois
                    new_roi = {
                        "canvas_id_rect": None,
                        "canvas_id_text": None,
                        "name": roi_data["name"],
                        "coords_normalized": tuple(roi_data["coords_normalized"]), # Ensure tuple for consistency
                        "comparison_mode": roi_data["comparison_mode"]
                    }
                    self.rois.append(new_roi)
                
                self._redraw_rois() # Redraw all loaded ROIs
                messagebox.showinfo("Load ROIs", f"ROIs loaded from {file_path}")

            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                messagebox.showerror("Error", "Invalid JSON file format.")
            except Exception as e:
                messagebox.showerror("Error", f"Failed to load ROIs: {e}")

    def _on_closing(self):
        """Handle window closing event to release camera resources."""
        if self.camera_active:
            self._toggle_camera() # This will stop the camera and release resources
        self.parent.destroy()

"""
Image processing functions for the ROI-Inspector application.
"""
import cv2
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import pytesseract
import Levenshtein
import difflib

# Configure Tesseract (you might need to change this path)
# pytesseract.pytesseract.tesseract_cmd = r'C:\Program Files\Tesseract-OCR\tesseract.exe'


def _extract_roi_from_image(image_pillow: Image.Image, roi_coords_normalized: tuple) -> np.ndarray:
    """
    Helper function to extract an ROI from a Pillow Image and convert it to OpenCV format.
    """
    img_width, img_height = image_pillow.size
    norm_x1, norm_y1, norm_x2, norm_y2 = roi_coords_normalized

    x1 = int(norm_x1 * img_width)
    y1 = int(norm_y1 * img_height)
    x2 = int(norm_x2 * img_width)
    y2 = int(norm_y2 * img_height)

    x1 = max(0, x1)
    y1 = max(0, y1)
    x2 = min(img_width, x2)
    y2 = min(img_height, y2)

    if x2 <= x1 or y2 <= y1:
        return np.array([]) # Return empty array for invalid ROI

    roi_image_pillow = image_pillow.crop((x1, y1, x2, y2))
    
    # Ensure image is RGB before converting for OpenCV
    if roi_image_pillow.mode != 'RGB':
        roi_image_pillow = roi_image_pillow.convert('RGB')
    
    return cv2.cvtColor(np.array(roi_image_pillow), cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)


def perform_homography_alignment(
    ref_image_pillow: Image.Image,
    sample_image_pillow: Image.Image,
    ref_points: list, # List of (x, y) tuples for reference image
    sample_points: list # List of (x, y) tuples for sample image
) -> Image.Image:
    """
    Calculates homography and warps the sample image to align with the reference image.

    Args:
        ref_image_pillow: The reference image as a Pillow Image object.
        sample_image_pillow: The sample image as a Pillow Image object.
        ref_points: A list of 4 (x, y) pixel coordinates from the reference image.
        sample_points: A list of 4 (x, y) pixel coordinates from the sample image.

    Returns:
        A new Pillow Image object of the sample image, warped to align with the reference.
        Returns None if homography cannot be calculated.
    """
    # Convert Pillow images to OpenCV format (numpy arrays)
    # Ensure images are RGB before converting to BGR for OpenCV
    if ref_image_pillow.mode != 'RGB':
        ref_image_pillow = ref_image_pillow.convert('RGB')
    if sample_image_pillow.mode != 'RGB':
        sample_image_pillow = sample_image_pillow.convert('RGB')

    ref_image_cv = cv2.cvtColor(np.array(ref_image_pillow), cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
    sample_image_cv = cv2.cvtColor(np.array(sample_image_pillow), cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)

    # Convert points to numpy arrays suitable for cv2.findHomography
    src_pts = np.float32(sample_points).reshape(-1, 1, 2)
    dst_pts = np.float32(ref_points).reshape(-1, 1, 2)

    # Calculate Homography matrix
    # RANSAC is used to make the homography robust to outliers (misclicked points)
    M, mask = cv2.findHomography(src_pts, dst_pts, cv2.RANSAC, 5.0)

    if M is None:
        return None # Homography could not be calculated

    # Warp the sample image to align with the reference
    # The output size should match the reference image dimensions
    h, w, _ = ref_image_cv.shape
    aligned_sample_cv = cv2.warpPerspective(sample_image_cv, M, (w, h))

    # Convert the aligned OpenCV image back to Pillow format
    aligned_sample_pillow = Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(aligned_sample_cv, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))

    return aligned_sample_pillow

def extract_text_from_roi(image_pillow: Image.Image, roi_coords_normalized: tuple) -> str:
    """
    Extracts text from a specified ROI within a Pillow Image using Tesseract OCR.

    Args:
        image_pillow: The source image as a Pillow Image object.
        roi_coords_normalized: A tuple (norm_x1, norm_y1, norm_x2, norm_y2) representing
                               the ROI with normalized coordinates (0-1).

    Returns:
        The extracted text as a string.
    """
    roi_image_cv = _extract_roi_from_image(image_pillow, roi_coords_normalized)
    if roi_image_cv.size == 0:
        return ""

    # Preprocessing for OCR (example: grayscale, threshold)
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(roi_image_cv, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    _, thresh_image_cv = cv2.threshold(gray, 0, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY + cv2.THRESH_OTSU)

    # Perform OCR
    text = pytesseract.image_to_string(thresh_image_cv, lang='eng') # 'eng' for English

    return text.strip()

def compare_text(text1: str, text2: str) -> dict:
    """
    Compares two text strings and returns similarity metrics and highlighted differences.

    Args:
        text1: The first text string (e.g., from reference ROI).
        text2: The second text string (e.g., from aligned sample ROI).

    Returns:
        A dictionary containing:
        - "similarity_ratio": float (using difflib.SequenceMatcher)
        - "levenshtein_distance": int
        - "highlighted_diff": str (unified diff format)
    """
    # Calculate similarity ratio using difflib
    s = difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, text1, text2)
    similarity_ratio = round(s.ratio(), 3)

    # Calculate Levenshtein distance
    levenshtein_distance = Levenshtein.distance(text1, text2)

    # Generate highlighted differences (unified diff format)
    diff = difflib.unified_diff(text1.splitlines(keepends=True), text2.splitlines(keepends=True), lineterm='')
    highlighted_diff = "".join(diff)

    return {
        "similarity_ratio": similarity_ratio,
        "levenshtein_distance": levenshtein_distance,
        "highlighted_diff": highlighted_diff
    }

def compare_shapes_in_roi(ref_image_pillow: Image.Image, sample_image_pillow: Image.Image, roi_coords_normalized: tuple) -> dict:
    """
    Compares shapes/contours within a specified ROI in two images.

    Args:
        ref_image_pillow: The reference image as a Pillow Image object.
        sample_image_pillow: The sample image as a Pillow Image object (aligned).
        roi_coords_normalized: A tuple (norm_x1, norm_y1, norm_x2, norm_y2) representing
                               the ROI with normalized coordinates (0-1).

    Returns:
        A dictionary containing:
        - "match_score": float (from cv2.matchShapes, lower is better)
        - "pass_fail": bool (based on a threshold)
    """
    ref_roi_cv = _extract_roi_from_image(ref_image_pillow, roi_coords_normalized)
    sample_roi_cv = _extract_roi_from_image(sample_image_pillow, roi_coords_normalized)

    if ref_roi_cv.size == 0 or sample_roi_cv.size == 0:
        return {"match_score": float('inf'), "pass_fail": False}

    # Preprocessing for contour finding
    ref_gray = cv2.cvtColor(ref_roi_cv, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    sample_gray = cv2.cvtColor(sample_roi_cv, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)

    # Apply Gaussian blur to reduce noise and help contour finding
    ref_blur = cv2.GaussianBlur(ref_gray, (5, 5), 0)
    sample_blur = cv2.GaussianBlur(sample_gray, (5, 5), 0)

    # Edge detection (Canny is a good choice)
    ref_edges = cv2.Canny(ref_blur, 50, 150)
    sample_edges = cv2.Canny(sample_blur, 50, 150)

    # Find contours
    ref_contours, _ = cv2.findContours(ref_edges, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)
    sample_contours, _ = cv2.findContours(sample_edges, cv2.RETR_EXTERNAL, cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_SIMPLE)

    # Simple comparison: compare the largest contour from each
    if not ref_contours or not sample_contours:
        return {"match_score": float('inf'), "pass_fail": False} # No contours found

    # Get the largest contour for comparison
    ref_largest_contour = max(ref_contours, key=cv2.contourArea)
    sample_largest_contour = max(sample_contours, key=cv2.contourArea)

    # Use cv2.matchShapes to compare
    # Different methods exist: cv2.CONTOURS_MATCH_I1, I2, I3 (Hu moments based)
    match_score = cv2.matchShapes(ref_largest_contour, sample_largest_contour, cv2.CONTOURS_MATCH_I1, 0)

    # Define a simple threshold for pass/fail (this might need tuning)
    threshold = 0.5 # Lower score means better match
    pass_fail = match_score < threshold

    return {
        "match_score": round(match_score, 3),
        "pass_fail": pass_fail
    }

import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, filedialog, messagebox, simpledialog
from PIL import Image, ImageTk
import fitz # PyMuPDF

import cv2 # For camera access
import numpy as np # For image processing and homography
from roi_inspector.processing import perform_homography_alignment, extract_text_from_roi, compare_text, compare_shapes_in_roi # For homography calculation, OCR, text and shape comparison

class MainApplication(ttk.Frame):
    """
    The main application window.
    """
    def __init__(self, parent, *args, **kwargs):
        ttk.Frame.__init__(self, parent, *args, **kwargs)
        self.parent = parent
        self.parent.title("ROI-Inspector")
        self.parent.geometry("1200x800")

        self.grid(column=0, row=0, sticky=(tk.N, tk.S, tk.E, tk.W))
        self.parent.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.parent.grid_rowconfigure(0, weight=1)

        self.reference_pillow_image = None # Stores the original Pillow Image object for reference
        self.sample_pillow_image = None    # Stores the original Pillow Image object for sample

        self.reference_tk_image = None # Stores the PhotoImage for reference canvas
        self.sample_tk_image = None    # Stores the PhotoImage for sample canvas

        # ROI Management
        # Each ROI dict will have:
        # "name": str, "coords_normalized": (x1, y1, x2, y2), "comparison_mode": str,
        # "canvas_id_rect": int (canvas object ID for rectangle), "canvas_id_text": int (canvas object ID for text)
        self.rois = []
        self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.selected_roi = None # Stores the currently selected ROI dictionary from self.rois
        self.start_x = None
        self.start_y = None
        self.current_roi_rect_id = None # ID of the rectangle being drawn temporarily

        # Alignment Point Management
        self.alignment_mode_enabled = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.reference_alignment_points = [] # Stores (x, y) pixel coordinates on the canvas
        self.reference_alignment_point_ids = [] # Stores canvas object IDs for points and numbers
        self.sample_alignment_points = [] # Stores (x, y) pixel coordinates on the canvas
        self.sample_alignment_point_ids = [] # Stores canvas object IDs for points and numbers

        # Camera Management
        self.cap = None # OpenCV VideoCapture object
        self.camera_active = False # Flag to indicate if camera is running
        self.current_camera_job = None # Stores the after() ID for camera feed updates
        self.camera_active_var = tk.BooleanVar(value=False) # Variable for the Toggle Camera button

        # Aligned Image
        self.aligned_sample_image = None # Stores the Pillow Image object after alignment


        self._create_widgets()
        self._create_menu()

        # Bind the configure event to handle resizing
        self.reference_canvas.bind("<Configure>", lambda event: self._on_canvas_resize(event, self.reference_canvas, self.reference_pillow_image))
        self.sample_canvas.bind("<Configure>", lambda event: self._on_canvas_resize(event, self.sample_canvas, self.sample_pillow_image))

        # Bind mouse events for ROI drawing/selection on reference canvas
        self.reference_canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self._on_mouse_down)
        self.reference_canvas.bind("<B1-Motion>", self._on_mouse_drag)
        self.reference_canvas.bind("<ButtonRelease-1>", self._on_mouse_up)
        
        # Bind right-click for context menu on reference canvas
        self.reference_canvas.bind("<Button-3>", self._on_right_click)

        # Bind mouse events for alignment point selection on sample canvas
        self.sample_canvas.bind("<ButtonPress-1>", self._on_sample_mouse_down)

        # Bind closing event to release camera resources
        self.parent.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self._on_closing)

    def _create_menu(self):
        menubar = tk.Menu(self.parent)
        self.parent.config(menu=menubar)

        file_menu = tk.Menu(menubar, tearoff=0)
        menubar.add_cascade(label="File", menu=file_menu)
        file_menu.add_command(label="Open Reference Image...", command=self._open_reference_image)
        file_menu.add_command(label="Open Reference PDF...", command=self._open_reference_pdf)
        file_menu.add_separator()
        file_menu.add_command(label="Open Sample Image...", command=self._open_sample_image)
        file_menu.add_separator()
        file_menu.add_command(label="Save ROIs...", command=self._save_rois_to_json)
        file_menu.add_command(label="Load ROIs...", command=self._load_rois_from_json)
        file_menu.add_separator()
        file_menu.add_command(label="Exit", command=self.parent.quit)

    def _create_widgets(self):
        """
        Creates the widgets for the main application window.
        """
        # Paned window to allow resizing of the two main areas (images)
        paned_window = ttk.PanedWindow(self, orient=tk.HORIZONTAL)
        paned_window.grid(row=0, column=0, sticky=(tk.N, tk.S, tk.E, tk.W))
        self.grid_columnconfigure(0, weight=1)
        self.grid_rowconfigure(0, weight=3) # Give more space to images

        # Left side for the sample image
        sample_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(paned_window, text="Sample Image")
        paned_window.add(sample_frame, weight=1)

        # Right side for the reference image
        reference_frame = ttk.LabelFrame(paned_window, text="Reference Image")
        paned_window.add(reference_frame, weight=1)

        # Sample image canvas
        self.sample_canvas = tk.Canvas(sample_frame, bg="gray")
        self.sample_canvas.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Reference image canvas
        self.reference_canvas = tk.Canvas(reference_frame, bg="lightgray")
        self.reference_canvas.pack(fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        # Control Frame
        control_frame = ttk.Frame(self) # Attach to self (MainApplication)
        control_frame.grid(row=1, column=0, sticky=(tk.E, tk.W), padx=10, pady=5)
        self.grid_rowconfigure(1, weight=0) # Control frame doesn't expand vertically

        # Results Panel at the bottom
        results_panel = ttk.LabelFrame(self, text="Comparison Results")
        results_panel.grid(row=2, column=0, sticky=(tk.N, tk.S, tk.E, tk.W), padx=10, pady=5)
        self.grid_rowconfigure(2, weight=1) # Results panel expands vertically

        self.comparison_results_text = tk.Text(results_panel, wrap=tk.WORD, state=tk.DISABLED, height=10)
        self.comparison_results_text.pack(side=tk.LEFT, fill=tk.BOTH, expand=True)

        results_scrollbar = ttk.Scrollbar(results_panel, command=self.comparison_results_text.yview)
        results_scrollbar.pack(side=tk.RIGHT, fill=tk.Y)
        self.comparison_results_text.config(yscrollcommand=results_scrollbar.set)

        self.draw_roi_button = ttk.Checkbutton(
            control_frame,
            text="Draw ROI",
            variable=self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled,
            command=self._toggle_roi_drawing_mode,
            style="ToggleButton.TCheckbutton"
        )
        self.draw_roi_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        self.define_alignment_button = ttk.Checkbutton(
            control_frame,
            text="Define Alignment Points",
            variable=self.alignment_mode_enabled,
            command=self._toggle_alignment_mode,
            style="ToggleButton.TCheckbutton"
        )
        self.define_alignment_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        self.toggle_camera_button = ttk.Checkbutton(
            control_frame,
            text="Toggle Camera",
            variable=self.camera_active_var, # Use the instance variable
            command=self._toggle_camera,
            style="ToggleButton.TCheckbutton"
        )
        self.toggle_camera_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        self.perform_alignment_button = ttk.Button(
            control_frame,
            text="Perform Alignment",
            command=self._perform_alignment
        )
        self.perform_alignment_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        self.perform_comparison_button = ttk.Button(
            control_frame,
            text="Perform Comparison",
            command=self._perform_comparison
        )
        self.perform_comparison_button.pack(side=tk.LEFT, padx=5)

        # Style for the Checkbutton to look like a toggle button
        style = ttk.Style()
        style.configure("ToggleButton.TCheckbutton", font=("TkDefaultFont", 10), padding=5)
        style.map("ToggleButton.TCheckbutton",
                  background=[("selected", "blue"), ("!selected", "lightgray")],
                  foreground=[("selected", "white"), ("!selected", "black")])

    def _toggle_roi_drawing_mode(self):
        if self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.get():
            print("ROI Drawing Mode Enabled")
            self.reference_canvas.config(cursor="cross")
            self._deselect_roi() # Deselect any ROI when entering drawing mode
            self.alignment_mode_enabled.set(False) # Disable alignment mode
            self._clear_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_point_ids) # Clear alignment points on canvas
            self.reference_alignment_points.clear() # Clear stored points
            self.reference_alignment_point_ids.clear()
        else:
            print("ROI Drawing Mode Disabled")
            self.reference_canvas.config(cursor="")

    def _toggle_alignment_mode(self):
        if self.alignment_mode_enabled.get():
            print("Alignment Mode Enabled")
            self.reference_canvas.config(cursor="cross")
            self._deselect_roi() # Deselect any ROI when entering alignment mode
            self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.set(False) # Disable ROI drawing mode
            self._clear_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_point_ids) # Clear existing points when re-entering mode
            self.reference_alignment_points.clear() # Clear stored points
            self.reference_alignment_point_ids.clear()
            self._clear_alignment_points(self.sample_canvas, self.sample_alignment_point_ids) # Clear existing points when re-entering mode
            self.sample_alignment_points.clear() # Clear stored points
            self.sample_alignment_point_ids.clear()
        else:
            print("Alignment Mode Disabled")
            self.reference_canvas.config(cursor="")

    def _on_mouse_down(self, event):
        if self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.get() and self.reference_pillow_image:
            self._deselect_roi() # Deselect existing ROI when starting a new draw
            self.start_x = self.reference_canvas.canvasx(event.x)
            self.start_y = self.reference_canvas.canvasy(event.y)
            self.current_roi_rect_id = self.reference_canvas.create_rectangle(
                self.start_x, self.start_y, self.start_x, self.start_y,
                outline="red", width=2, tags="roi_rect"
            )
        elif self.alignment_mode_enabled.get() and self.reference_pillow_image:
            if len(self.reference_alignment_points) < 4:
                x, y = self.reference_canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.reference_canvas.canvasy(event.y)
                self.reference_alignment_points.append((x, y))
                self._draw_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_points, self.reference_alignment_point_ids)
                print(f"Reference point {len(self.reference_alignment_points)}: ({x}, {y})")
                if len(self.reference_alignment_points) == 4:
                    messagebox.showinfo("Alignment Points", "Four alignment points selected for reference image.")
            else:
                messagebox.showinfo("Alignment Points", "Four alignment points already selected. Clearing previous points.")
                self._clear_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_point_ids)
                self.reference_alignment_points.clear()
                x, y = self.reference_canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.reference_canvas.canvasy(event.y)
                self.reference_alignment_points.append((x, y))
                self._draw_alignment_points(self.reference_canvas, self.reference_alignment_points, self.reference_alignment_point_ids)
                print(f"Reference point 1: ({x}, {y})")
        elif not self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.get() and not self.alignment_mode_enabled.get(): # ROI selection mode
            self._select_roi_at_coords(event.x, event.y)


    def _on_mouse_drag(self, event):
        if self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.get() and self.current_roi_rect_id:
            cur_x = self.reference_canvas.canvasx(event.x)
            cur_y = self.reference_canvas.canvasy(event.y)
            self.reference_canvas.coords(self.current_roi_rect_id, self.start_x, self.start_y, cur_x, cur_y)

    def _on_mouse_up(self, event):
        if self.roi_drawing_mode_enabled.get() and self.current_roi_rect_id:
            end_x = self.reference_canvas.canvasx(event.x)
            end_y = self.reference_canvas.canvasy(event.y)

            # Ensure start < end for rectangle coordinates
            x1, y1 = min(self.start_x, end_x), min(self.start_y, end_y)
            x2, y2 = max(self.start_x, end_x), max(self.start_y, end_y)

            # Check for minimum size to avoid tiny ROIs
            if abs(x2 - x1) < 5 or abs(y2 - y1) < 5: # 5 pixel minimum size
                self.reference_canvas.delete(self.current_roi_rect_id)
                self.current_roi_rect_id = None
                self.start_x = None
                self.start_y = None
                return

            # Get canvas dimensions
            canvas_width = self.reference_canvas.winfo_width()
            canvas_height = self.reference_canvas.winfo_height()

            # If no reference image is loaded, cannot normalize. Delete ROI.
            if not self.reference_pillow_image:
                self.reference_canvas.delete(self.current_roi_rect_id)
                self.current_roi_rect_id = None
                self.start_x = None
                self.start_y = None
                messagebox.showwarning("Warning", "Please load a reference image before drawing ROIs.")
                return

            original_img_width, original_img_height = self.reference_pillow_image.size
                
            # Calculate the dimensions of the *displayed* image on the canvas
            img_ratio = original_img_width / original_img_height
            canvas_ratio = canvas_width / canvas_height
            
            displayed_img_width = canvas_width
            displayed_img_height = int(canvas_width / img_ratio)
            
            if displayed_img_height > canvas_height:
                displayed_img_height = canvas_height
                displayed_img_width = int(canvas_height * img_ratio)

            # Calculate offset if image is not centered
            offset_x = (canvas_width - displayed_img_width) / 2
            offset_y = (canvas_height - displayed_img_height) / 2
            
            # Convert canvas pixel coordinates to normalized (0-1 range) relative to the *displayed* image
            norm_x1 = (x1 - offset_x) / displayed_img_width
            norm_y1 = (y1 - offset_y) / displayed_img_height
            norm_x2 = (x2 - offset_x) / displayed_img_width
            norm_y2 = (y2 - offset_y) / displayed_img_height
            
            # Clamp normalized coordinates to [0, 1] range
            norm_x1 = max(0.0, min(1.0, norm_x1))
            norm_y1 = max(0.0, min(1.0, norm_y1))
            norm_x2 = max(0.0, min(1.0, norm_x2))
            norm_y2 = max(0.0, min(1.0, norm_y2))

            roi_name = simpledialog.askstring("ROI Name", "Enter name for this ROI:")
            if roi_name:
                new_roi = {
                    "canvas_id_rect": self.current_roi_rect_id, # Store the canvas object ID for the rectangle
                    "canvas_id_text": None, # Will be set during redraw
                    "name": roi_name,
                    "coords_normalized": (norm_x1, norm_y1, norm_x2, norm_y2),
                    "comparison_mode": "OCR" # Default mode
                }
                self.rois.append(new_roi)
                print(f"Added ROI: {new_roi}")
                self._redraw_rois() # Redraw all ROIs to correctly display the new one with its name
            else:
                self.reference_canvas.delete(self.current_roi_rect_id) # Delete if no name
            
            self.current_roi_rect_id = None
            self.start_x = None
            self.start_y = None

    def _on_sample_mouse_down(self, event):
        if self.alignment_mode_enabled.get() and self.sample_pillow_image:
            if len(self.sample_alignment_points) < 4:
                x, y = self.sample_canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.sample_canvas.canvasy(event.y)
                self.sample_alignment_points.append((x, y))
                self._draw_alignment_points(self.sample_canvas, self.sample_alignment_points, self.sample_alignment_point_ids)
                print(f"Sample point {len(self.sample_alignment_points)}: ({x}, {y})")
                if len(self.sample_alignment_points) == 4:
                    messagebox.showinfo("Alignment Points", "Four alignment points selected for sample image.")
            else:
                messagebox.showinfo("Alignment Points", "Four alignment points already selected. Clearing previous points.")
                self._clear_alignment_points(self.sample_canvas, self.sample_alignment_point_ids)
                self.sample_alignment_points.clear()
                x, y = self.sample_canvas.canvasx(event.x), self.sample_canvas.canvasy(event.y)
                self.sample_alignment_points.append((x, y))
                self._draw_alignment_points(self.sample_canvas, self.sample_alignment_points, self.sample_alignment_point_ids)
                print(f"Sample point 1: ({x}, {y})")

    def _perform_alignment(self):
        if not self.reference_pillow_image:
            messagebox.showwarning("Alignment", "Please load a reference image first.")
            return
        if not self.sample_pillow_image:
            messagebox.showwarning("Alignment", "Please load a sample image or start camera first.")
            return

        if len(self.reference_alignment_points) != 4:
            messagebox.showwarning("Alignment", "Please select 4 alignment points on the reference image.")
            return
        if len(self.sample_alignment_points) != 4:
            messagebox.showwarning("Alignment", "Please select 4 alignment points on the sample image.")
            return
        
        # Ensure alignment mode is off after defining points
        self.alignment_mode_enabled.set(False) 

        # Call the processing function
        aligned_img = perform_homography_alignment(
            self.reference_pillow_image,
            self.sample_pillow_image,
            self.reference_alignment_points,
            self.sample_alignment_points
        )

        if aligned_img:
            self.aligned_sample_image = aligned_img
            # Display the aligned image on the sample canvas
            self._update_canvas_image(self.sample_canvas, self.aligned_sample_image, 'sample_tk_image')
            messagebox.showinfo("Alignment", "Image alignment successful!")
        else:
            messagebox.showerror("Alignment", "Failed to perform homography alignment. Check selected points.")

    def _perform_comparison(self):
        if not self.reference_pillow_image:
            messagebox.showwarning("Comparison", "Please load a reference image first.")
            return
        if not self.aligned_sample_image:
            messagebox.showwarning("Comparison", "Please perform alignment first.")
            return
        if not self.rois:
            messagebox.showwarning("Comparison", "Please define ROIs first.")
            return

        all_comparison_results = []
        for i, roi in enumerate(self.rois):
            if roi["comparison_mode"] == "OCR":
                # Temporarily disable OCR processing due to Tesseract not found
                result_str = (
                    f"ROI '{roi['name']}' (OCR Mode):\n"
                    f"  OCR processing temporarily disabled. Tesseract OCR engine not found.\n"
                    f"  Please install Tesseract and ensure it's in your system PATH.\n"
                    f"  See README for more details.\n"
                    "-----------------------------------------\n"
                )
                all_comparison_results.append(result_str)
            elif roi["comparison_mode"] == "Shape":
                # Perform shape comparison
                shape_comparison_result = compare_shapes_in_roi(
                    self.reference_pillow_image,
                    self.aligned_sample_image,
                    roi["coords_normalized"]
                )
                result_str = (
                    f"ROI '{roi['name']}' (Shape Mode):\n"
                    f"  Match Score (lower is better): {shape_comparison_result['match_score']:.3f}\n"
                    f"  Pass/Fail: {'Pass' if shape_comparison_result['pass_fail'] else 'Fail'}\n"
                    "-----------------------------------------\n"
                )
                all_comparison_results.append(result_str)
            else:
                result_str = (
                    f"ROI '{roi['name']}' (Unknown Mode: {roi['comparison_mode']}):\n"
                    f"  Comparison mode not recognized.\n"
                    "-----------------------------------------\n"
                )
                all_comparison_results.append(result_str)

        # Clear previous results
        self.comparison_results_text.config(state=tk.NORMAL)
        self.comparison_results_text.delete(1.0, tk.END)

        if all_comparison_results:
            self.comparison_results_text.insert(tk.END, "".join(all_comparison_results))
        else:
            self.comparison_results_text.insert(tk.END, "No ROIs defined for comparison.")
        
        self.comparison_results_text.config(state=tk.DISABLED)


    def _on_right_click(self, event):

            self._select_roi_at_coords(event.x, event.y)

                context_menu = tk.Menu(self.reference_canvas, tearoff=0)
                context_menu.add_command(label=f"Rename '{self.selected_roi['name']}'", command=self._rename_selected_roi)
                
                # Submenu for comparison mode
